poe.note: R8N87A. Datasheet: PoE capability 370W Class 4 PoE/PoE+; official spec lists 'POE power 370W of Class 4: R8N85A, R8N87A'. Max power 32.7W w/o PoE, 455W w/ PoE, so 370W is the PD allocation, not the PSU.
R8N85A. Datasheet: PoE capability 370W Class 4 PoE/PoE+; 'POE power 370W of Class 4: R8N85A'. Max power 45W w/o PoE, 480W w/ PoE.
Published 'Total PoE available 250W'. Caveat: 250W is also the PSU rating and non-PoE draw is 30W, so usable PD headroom is ~220W; the catalogue figure matches the manufacturer's own PoE figure.

No published PoE budget. Datasheet gives only 'Power supply AC/DC internal 500W' and 'Max power consumption: includes PoE output 500W / excludes PoE output 30W', so 500W is the PSU rating, not a PoE allocation; implied PD headroom is ~470W. Sibling models do publish 'Total PoE available' equal to their model wattage, so 500W is plausible but unconfirmed.
Published 'Total PoE available 500W'. PSU is also 500W and non-PoE draw is 64W; 500W is Ubiquiti's own PoE figure and matches the catalogue.

Datasheet: 'Total PoE Availability 600W'. Catalogue declared no budget (engine fell back to 0W, so all 52 PSE ports source nothing and the UI shows 'budget not modelled'). Data gap, not a wrong number.
